text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, cisatracurium besylate is not on FDA's drug shortage list. FDA's record shows the product status as "To Be Discontinued" with no effective date provided. No public FDA signal exists at the plants supplying our current inventory. Corvale East holds 39 vials at 3.5 per day for 11.2 days on hand; Corvale General holds 126 vials at 4.1 per day for 31 days on hand; Corvale Lakeside holds 23 vials at 0.8 per day for 29.6 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA lists the product status as "To Be Discontinued since -" with no date. The drug shortage list does not include cisatracurium besylate as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers near-term use at all three sites. The rule-based best option is to buy from Armas Pharmaceuticals, which is not on FDA's shortage list today. Alternative manufacturers Avenacy, LLC and Camber Pharmaceuticals Inc. are also not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Armas Pharmaceuticals as primary source; buyer approves.
2. Buyer to qualify Avenacy, LLC and Camber Pharmaceuticals Inc. as secondary sources; buyer approves.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list and discontinuation status weekly; buyer approves.
4. Pharmacy director to review allocation if any site falls below 14 days on hand; pharmacy director approves.

Not recommended: Switching to alternative neuromuscular blocking agents or changing clinical protocols at this time.
